pr_title: _terms_enum for doc value only keyword fields
pr_comments: Hi @ywelsch, I've created a changelog YAML for you.

issue_context.title: Add `_terms_enum` support for `keyword` doc-value-only fileds
issue_context.body:
### Description

The `_terms_enum`  API could leverage the terms dictionary of doc values to provide term suggestions on `keyword` doc-value-only fields.

cc @ywelsch

review_comments: Is there a reason why `MultiDocValues.getSortedSetValues(reader, name()).termsEnum()` wouldn't work?

First of all, thanks for pointing me to that class (I wasn't aware of it).
- `MultiDocValues.getSortedSetValues` looks to build global ordinals (which `MultiTerms` doesn't do), i.e. more effort up-front.
- `MultiTerms` exposes the terms enum via `MultiTermsEnum`, which does a merge sort on retrieval by term text.
What would you recommend?

Ah, I was thinking "wait we already have logic to merge multiple doc values instances", I had forgotten that it would build global ordinals under the hood. Merging terms on the fly rather than up-front makes more sense indeed.
Can you leave a comment about why it's not using MultiDocValues?
